summary_1line: Duryodhana fiercely assaults the Pandavas before Drona battles and kills the Kekaya prince Vrihatkshatra, as multiple duels rage across the battlefield.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana stands on his chariot drawing his golden-backed bow into a perfect circle as arrows pour toward the surrounding Pandava warriors.
Drona releases a deadly shaft that pierces through the armored chest of the Kekaya prince Vrihatkshatra and buries itself in the earth behind him.
The wounded Vrihatkshatra, eyes blazing with rage, fires a storm of arrows at Drona while his chariot reels amid the chaos of battle.
